name: Northmen
summary:
Northmen is a real-time strategy game set in the Viking Age from AD 793, presented as an homage to Norse culture. The map covers the whole world, so players can sail as far as Japan. The player leads a Norse war chief with eight settlers and four spearmen. Gameplay combines raiding and conquest, with options to sack, conquer, enslave or burn towns and plunder monasteries, building settlements from a longhouse to a great city, and developing trade by road and sea.

The game includes 53 historical peoples and over 1,100 towns, holy places of 20 faiths, 24 wonders, diplomacy with pacts and vassals, and an ending built on Ragnarök. It is single-player, uses pixel-art graphics and supports 27 languages.
